description: This file defines the 'daterange' field type plugin for Drupal, including class 'DateRangeItem' which extends 'DateTimeItem' and manages date range data with properties, schema, sample data generation, and change handling.

classes.name: DateRangeItem
classes.description: A Drupal field type plugin class for handling date ranges, extending DateTimeItem, with properties for start and end dates, schema definitions, sample value generation, and change handling.

methods.name: propertyDefinitions
methods.description: Defines data properties for start and end date values and computed date objects.

methods.name: schema
methods.description: Defines the database schema for storing date range values.

methods.name: storageSettingsForm
methods.description: Provides form elements for storage settings, including 'All Day' option.

methods.name: generateSampleValue
methods.description: Generates a sample date range value for testing or default purposes.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the date range field is empty.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Handles property change events, invalidating computed dates when start or end values change.
